_comment: Round two. Same cards as the first bake-off where they were decisive, plus the Film shelf. Each line carries production design (what the thing is made of, how worn it is), a light source that is motivated inside the scene, and one moment rather than one object — the things the terse round-one lines left to the model.
hero-product-reveal: A heavy matte-black glass flacon on a slab of wet black granite, its shoulder catching one hard stripe of light from a bare bulb swinging somewhere above and left, the swing visible as the highlight creeps along the curve. Fine condensation beads the lower third of the bottle. Below it, a mirror-perfect reflection breaking across a film of standing water.
kids-story: A needle-felted fox kit, every fibre of its coat individually raised, asleep in the gutter of an enormous open picture book. Hand-cut paper trees stand in layers behind it, their edges furred where the scissors went through, a warm desk lamp just out of frame throwing long soft shadows of them across the page. Dust turning slowly in the lamp beam.
headshots: A confident studio portrait of a man in his thirties in a charcoal wool jacket, three-quarter turn, eyes to camera, the faintest smile. One large softbox camera-left, turned slightly away so its light falls off gently across his face, and a subtle hair light separating him from a seamless mid-grey backdrop. Skin real and unretouched — pores, a day of stubble, a catchlight in each eye. Nothing theatrical: this is a portrait a person would put on a business card.
micro-expressions: An extreme close-up of an actor's eye and cheekbone, held on the half-second where the muscle beneath the lower lid tightens and the pupil contracts. Every eyelash separate, the iris textured like cut stone, the beginning of moisture along the waterline. Soft window light from camera-left, the far side of the face falling into shadow.
music-video: A black vinyl record turning on a heavy plinth deck in a dark room, the tone arm tracking and the stylus throwing a tiny point of light. A slow-moving coloured wash sweeps across the platter from a source behind the camera, so the grooves light up as a moving arc. Dust motes and a haze of smoke hanging in the beam.
film-trailer: A vast red velvet cinema curtain caught mid-sweep across a dark proscenium, its folds heavy and moving, the gilt edge of the arch just catching light. A single hard projector beam cuts across the top of frame through thick atmospheric haze, the silhouetted backs of empty front-row seats along the bottom.
game-trailer: A colossal cracked stone monolith standing in deep fog on a dark plain, light bleeding upward out of the fissures as though something inside it is waking. Carved surfaces worn illegibly smooth by weather. A lone figure silhouetted tiny at its base for scale.
game-cutscene: A lone armoured figure kneeling in the ruined nave of a cathedral, shot from low and behind so the shoulder plates fill the lower frame. Shafts of light fall through a collapsed roof into drifting dust and ash, catching on scratched, battle-worn metal. A distant archway glows at the far end of the hall.
noir-seduction: An empty hotel bed at night, sheets disturbed, striped hard by Venetian blind shadows thrown across the room from a street sign outside. A cigarette still burning in a heavy glass ashtray on the nightstand, its smoke column rising straight and then breaking into turbulence where it crosses the light.
automotive-ad: A dark sports car at speed on wet tarmac at night, shot low from the front quarter with the camera tracking alongside. Spray still hanging in the air off the rear wheel, headlights carving two solid cones through the rain, the road surface a field of broken reflections. Water beading and streaming backward along the flank.
